name: Pipeliners - Schema Markup Package 2026-08-19
body:
> Plan · Pipeliners · 2026-08-19

# Summary
Folder of 41 ready-to-deploy JSON-LD blocks: `00-homepage.json` (LocalBusiness entity), 37 files in `city-pages\` (one per city), 3 in `service-pages\` (epipe-restoration, hydro-jetting, trenchless-drain-pipe-repair) and `_ALL-BLOCKS.txt` (all wrapped in script tags). Zips of the package (`Pipeliners-Schema-Markup.zip`, `Pipeliners-Schema-AS-DEPLOYED.zip`) sit in the client root. The README explains deployment via OTTO custom HTML per URL.

# Design choices (README)
- Only Plumber/LocalBusiness (`@id` https://pipelinersusa.com/#business) and a page-specific Service referencing it. WebPage, BreadcrumbList and FAQPage deliberately left out to avoid duplicates.
- Business entity repeated in full on every page so each graph validates on its own.
- Values from GBP location 7809: name "Pipeliners" (alternateName "Pipeliners USA"), aggregateRating 4.9 from 122, hours Mon-Sun 00:00-23:59, maps CID, 7 social profiles, ROC 362960, Place ID, foundingDate 2020-12, live logo.
- Three phone numbers explained: 480-535-6503 (website tracking DID, used as telephone), the nav pool number, and the GBP number.

# What happened later
- Service + LocalBusiness schema went live on all 37 city pages via OTTO on Aug 18 (see [Pipeliners - Schema and Headings Report 2026-08-19](lib:brain-pipeliners-schema-and-headings-report-2026-08-19)). Never wrap OTTO slots in `@graph`.
- On Oct 8 the 24/7 hours and the aggregateRating were removed from 32 city-page schemas (self-serving reviews, no 24/7 claim). See [Pipeliners - Lesson Fix Steps 2026-10-08](lib:brain-pipeliners-lesson-fix-steps-2026-10-08).
